# Methodology

## What is measured

The system should be evaluated as separate stages: source capture, structured extraction, evidence attribution, record validation, and prioritisation. A high score at one stage does not establish end-to-end reliability.

## Initial benchmark design

Build a synthetic set containing clear, incomplete, ambiguous, and conflicting examples. Review expected fields and evidence spans before running model-assisted extraction. Keep a held-out set separate from development examples.

## Metrics

- Field-level precision and recall for extracted attributes.
- Classification metrics for requirement importance.
- Provenance coverage for claims that influence decisions.
- Unsupported-guess rate on intentionally underspecified inputs.
- Ranking agreement and score stability for prioritisation.

No performance claims should be made until this benchmark is implemented and run. Report sample size, uncertainty, known limitations, and representative failures.
